content: Current AI-assisted coding interview products/guidance (Google/Meta AI-assisted interview formats, AI interview copilots) treat clarifying-question behavior as a core evaluated skill, not just UX polish: tools like an interview 'AI Assistant' read the problem, ask clarifying questions when requirements are ambiguous, and produce a plan before code. Best-practice guidance is explicit: never silently assume — ask, or state assumptions and confirm edge cases/format before implementing, because silent wrong assumptions waste the whole attempt.
